column1: # The divergences the macro is to blame for. A line names a pattern in id
# syntax, whose unnamed axes are free and whose named values may be
# neutral; a finding as an outcome spells it; and one sentence saying what
# is wrong. A cell that diverges is excused when every finding that makes
# it diverge is excused by a line whose pattern matches it. A line that
# excuses no finding in a complete run fails the run as stale. Columns are
